newsitem.title: CANADA: CN West Coast traffic cut after accident.
newsitem.headline: CN West Coast traffic cut after accident.

text.p: Traffic on the Canadian National Railway Co's main line to Vancouver was disrupted Wednesday after an accident, a company spokesman said.
"It has disrupted traffic. The main line is shut for the time being," CN spokesman Jim Feeny said.
He said "an incident" occurred on the line early Wednesday but the railroad would have no further information until its investigators arrived at the scene near Lytton, British Columbia.

The Canadian Press news agency said several rail cars plunged into the Fraser River canyon, killing two crew members. The train derailed after a mudslide. The agency quoted witnesses as saying that two railcars loaded with sulphur were burning in the river.
